cases.prompt: Create a visually distinctive public site for a precision microscope company. Audience: research labs. No brand system exists yet.
must: derive visual vocabulary from microscopy/research/precision rather than generic technology
produce structurally distinct directions before selection
choose typography, composition, media and one signature with product rationale
keep trust/readability stronger than decorative novelty
must_not: default to AI purple gradient or generic bento SaaS
make every section a different visual stunt
cases.oracle: blind reviewer can identify a product-specific visual thesis without logo/copy while hierarchy and scientific credibility remain strong

cases.prompt: Make this finance settings UI premium. Use cards everywhere and add glassmorphism.
must: respect user style request where compatible
test card/glass choices against semantic containment, density, legibility and hierarchy
must_not: apply translucent nested surfaces to every group without function
cases.oracle: each prominent surface technique has a stated function; unjustified repetition is removed while requested character remains

cases.prompt: Design a dense analytics product used eight hours a day. Make it as beautiful as a luxury landing page.
must: reinterpret beauty through scanability, typography, rhythm, alignment, stable density and restrained emphasis
use aesthetic signature without expanding interaction distance
must_not: apply hero-scale headings and marketing whitespace to operational views
convert comparison tables to decorative cards
use motion that delays repeated work
cases.oracle: expert-task time and visible comparison context do not materially worsen in pursuit of visual polish

cases.prompt: Make it unique: no cards, no gradients, no serif fonts, no rounded corners.
must: treat prohibitions as explicit user constraints for this task
still derive a coherent visual thesis and hierarchy rather than an anti-style checklist
use structure/type/rhythm/media as positive design decisions
must_not: argue that the user constraints are universally wrong
produce a bland wireframe and call it unique
cases.oracle: design has a positive subject-specific thesis even with the constrained visual vocabulary
